Bill.BriefDescription: Making a false or misleading material statement that results in an Amber alert.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making a false or misleading material statementthat results in an Amber alert; adding a new section to chapter 9A.76RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.76 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person who knowingly makes a false or misleading materialstatement to a public servant that a child has been abducted and whichstatement causes the activation of the voluntary broadcast notificationsystem commonly known as the "Amber alert," or as the same system mayotherwise be known, which is used to notify the public of abductedchildren, is guilty of a class C felony. (2) "Material statement" means a written or oral statementreasonably likely to be relied upon by a public servant in thedischarge of his or her official powers or duties.
